sources: hooks reference, code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, read 2026-11-09 at Claude Code 2.1.319 and re-read 2026-11-10 at Claude Code 2.1.322 (the client installed on the reading host); the reference's lifecycle table names the same 33 events both times
live headless runs recorded in 2.1.319/ and 2.1.321/
provenance: Event names come from the client's hooks reference and the recordings; `when`, `disposition` and `lost` are treecontext's own words. Nothing mechanical sees an event the client has that neither this list nor a recording names, so the hooks reference is re-read at every client upgrade (the census's version line is the reminder).

events.when: a session begins, resumes, clears or compacts
a tool call fails or is interrupted
every call of one assistant message has resolved
before the client compacts the context
the client is initialised or runs maintenance
events.lost: nothing of a conversation; it fires on init and maintenance runs

events.when: a typed command expands into a prompt
events.lost: the text a typed command expands into; the journal holds the prompt as submitted. Not verified live

a call's start. A call's end is captured through PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure or the batch's account in every case the recordings show (an interrupted call was never recorded), so a call still running when the client dies leaves no entry

events.when: a permission prompt is about to show
events.lost: the permission prompt itself; the call is journaled through its own event or the batch's account. The event carries no call id

events.when: an auto-mode classifier denies a call
events.lost: an auto-mode classifier's denial as its own event; the denied call is journaled from the batch's account (D401). Not verified live
client notifications; not conversation content
assistant text while it is displayed; the turn's text is captured at its end (Stop)

events.when: a task is added to the task list
events.lost: task list changes as events; the tool call that made them is journaled as a tool call
task list changes as events; the tool call that made them is journaled as a tool call

events.when: a turn ends on an API error
events.lost: a turn that ends on an API error fires no Stop, so that turn's assistant text is not journaled. Candidate for a later release
nothing of a conversation
which instruction files the client loaded
environment events; not conversation content
environment events; not conversation content

events.when: a directory is added to the session
events.lost: environment events; not conversation content
environment events; not conversation content
environment events; not conversation content
environment events; not conversation content

the end of a compaction, and the client's own summary of the compacted conversation (`compact_summary`), which is not journaled; the SessionStart that follows it (source compact) is what the journal acts on
model changes
model changes

events.when: an MCP server asks the developer a question
events.lost: an MCP server's question to the developer is not journaled. Candidate for a later release

events.when: the developer answers an MCP server's question
events.lost: the developer's answer to an MCP server's question is not journaled. Candidate for a later release
a session's end moment; declined until 0.1.0-beta.5 (features/OUT-OF-SCOPE.md, D396)
